summary: preinstall reverse shell to hardcoded IP with install-time HTTP beacon
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that spawns an interactive bash bound to a TCP socket at 147.93.157.202:8080, giving a remote party interactive command execution on the installer's host the moment `npm install` runs. The same pipeline forwards shell output via `curl -X POST` over plaintext HTTP to http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php, providing an independent install-time beacon and exfiltration channel. The behavior fires automatically from the lifecycle hook and is unrelated to any legitimate function of an authentication library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
